G4100.def:
πιστεύω,
[in LXX chiefly for אמן hi. ;]
__1. intrans., to have faith (in), to believe; in cl., with accusative, dative, in NT also with prep, (on the significance of the various constructions, see M, Pr., 67f.; Vau. on Rm 4:5; Ellic. on 1Tm 1:16; Abbott, JV, 19-80): absol., Mt 24:23, 26 Mc 13:21, 1Co 11:18; with accusative of thing(s), At 13:41, 1Co 13:7; with dative of person(s) (to believe what one says), Mrk.16:[13, 14], 1Jo 4:1; τ. ψεύδει, 2Ts 2:11; περί . . . ὅτι, Jo 9:18; esp. and most frequently with reference to religious belief: absol., Mt 8:13, Mc 5:36, Lc 8:50, Jo 11:40, al.; before ὅτι, Mt 9:28, al.; with dative (see supr., and cf. DB, i, 829a), Jo 3:12 5:24 6:30 8:31, At 16:34, Gl 3:6" (LXX), 2Tm 1:12, 1Jo 5:10, al.; with prep., (expressing personal trust and reliance as distinct from mere credence or belief; see M, Pr., l.with; DB, i, 829b), to believe in or on: ἐν (Psa.77 (78):22, al.), Mc 1:15 (see Swete, in l.); εἰς, Mt 18:6, Jo 2:11 (see Westc., in l.), and freq., At 10:43 19:4, Rm 10:14, Gl 2:16, Fp 1:29, I Jo 5:10, 1Pe 1:8; εἰς τ. ὄνομα, Jo 1:12 2:23 3:18, 1Jo 5:13; ἐπί, with accusative, Mt 27:42, At 9:42 11:17 16:31 22:19, Rm 4:5; ἐπί, with dative, Rm 9:33 (LXX) 10:11 (ib.), 1Tm 1:16, 1Pe 2:6" (LXX) ; ptcp. pres., οἱ π., as subst., At 2:44, Rm 3:22, 1Co 1:21, al.; aor., Mrk.16:[16], At 4:32; pf., At 19:18 21:20 (on Johannine use of the tenses of π., see Westc, Epp. Jo., 120).
__2. Trans., to entrust: with accusative and dative, Lc 16:11, Jo 2:24; pass., to be entrusted with: with accusative, Rm 3:2, 1Co 9:17, Gl 2:7, 1Ts 2:4 (see Lft., Notes, 21f.), 1Tm 1:11, Tt 1:3.
(AS)

G4101.def:
πιστικός, -ή, -όν (πίστις),
__1. having the gift of persuasion (Plat., Gorg., 455A).
__2.
__(a) of persons, faithful, trusty (Plut.);
__(b) of things, trustworthy, genuine: νάρδος π., Mc 14:3, Jo 12:3.
† (AS)

G4102G.def:
πίστις, -εως, ἡ
(πείθω), [in LXX chiefly for אֱמוּנָה ;]
__1. in active sense, faith, belief, trust, confidence, in NT always of religious faith in God or Christ or spiritual things: Mt 8:10, Lc 5:20, At 14:9, Rm 1:8, 1Co 2:5, 2Co 1:24, 1Tm 1:5, al.; with genitive obj., Mc 11:22, At 3:16, Rm 3:22, Gl 2:16, Ef 3:12, Tg 2:1, al.; with prep., ἐν, Rm 3:25, Gl 3:26, Ef 1:15, Cl 1:24, 1Tm 1:14 3:13, 2Tm 1:13 3:15, 2Pe 1:1; εἰς, At 20:21 24:24 26:18, Cl 2:5, 1Pe 1:21; πρός, 1Ts 1:8, Phm 5; ἐπί, with accusative Hb 6:1; ἐν τῇ π. στήκειν (εἶναι, μένειν), 1Co 16:13, 1Co 13:5, 1Tm 2:15; ὑπακοὴ τῆς π., Rm 1:5 16:26; ὁ ἐκ π., Rm 3:26 4:16, Gl 3:12; διὰ (τῆς) π., Rm 3:30, Gl 2:16, Fp 3:9. By meton., objectively, that which is the object or content of belief, the faith: At 6:7 14:22, Gl 1:23 3:23 6:10, Fp 1:26, 27 Ju 3, 20, and perh. also At 13:8 16:5, Rm 1:5 and 16:26 (see supr.), 1Co 16:13, Cl 1:23, 2Ts 3:2 (Lft., Notes, 125), 1Tm 1:19 3:9 4:1, 6 5:8 6:10, 12, 2Tm 3:8 4:7 Tt 1:4, 13 3:15, 1Pe 5:9.
__2. In passive sense,
__(a) fidelity, faithfulness: Mt 23:23, Gl 5:22; ἡ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, Rm 3:3;
__(b) objectively, plighted faith, a pledge of fidelity: 1Tm 5:12. (On the various shades of meaning in which the word is used in NT, see esp. ICC on Rm 1:17, pp. 31ff.; Lft., Ga., 154ff.; Stevens, Th. NT, 422, 515ff.; DB, i, 830ff.; Cremer, see word)
(AS)

G4102H.def:
πίστις, -εως, ἡ
(πείθω), [in LXX chiefly for אֱמוּנָה ;]
__1. in active sense, faith, belief, trust, confidence, in NT always of religious faith in God or Christ or spiritual things: Mt 8:10, Lc 5:20, At 14:9, Rm 1:8, 1Co 2:5, 2Co 1:24, 1Tm 1:5, al.; with genitive obj., Mc 11:22, At 3:16, Rm 3:22, Gl 2:16, Ef 3:12, Tg 2:1, al.; with prep., ἐν, Rm 3:25, Gl 3:26, Ef 1:15, Cl 1:24, 1Tm 1:14 3:13, 2Tm 1:13 3:15, 2Pe 1:1; εἰς, At 20:21 24:24 26:18, Cl 2:5, 1Pe 1:21; πρός, 1Ts 1:8, Phm 5; ἐπί, with accusative Hb 6:1; ἐν τῇ π. στήκειν (εἶναι, μένειν), 1Co 16:13, 1Co 13:5, 1Tm 2:15; ὑπακοὴ τῆς π., Rm 1:5 16:26; ὁ ἐκ π., Rm 3:26 4:16, Gl 3:12; διὰ (τῆς) π., Rm 3:30, Gl 2:16, Fp 3:9. By meton., objectively, that which is the object or content of belief, the faith: At 6:7 14:22, Gl 1:23 3:23 6:10, Fp 1:26, 27 Ju 3, 20, and perh. also At 13:8 16:5, Rm 1:5 and 16:26 (see supr.), 1Co 16:13, Cl 1:23, 2Ts 3:2 (Lft., Notes, 125), 1Tm 1:19 3:9 4:1, 6 5:8 6:10, 12, 2Tm 3:8 4:7 Tt 1:4, 13 3:15, 1Pe 5:9.
__2. In passive sense,
__(a) fidelity, faithfulness: Mt 23:23, Gl 5:22; ἡ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, Rm 3:3;
__(b) objectively, plighted faith, a pledge of fidelity: 1Tm 5:12. (On the various shades of meaning in which the word is used in NT, see esp. ICC on Rm 1:17, pp. 31ff.; Lft., Ga., 154ff.; Stevens, Th. NT, 422, 515ff.; DB, i, 830ff.; Cremer, see word)
(AS)

G4103.def:
πιστός, -ή, -όν
(πείθω), [in LXX chiefly for אָמַן ;]
__I. Pass., to be trusted or believed;
__1. of persons, trusty, faithful : Mt 24:45 25:21, 23 Lc 12:42, At 16:15, 1Co 4:2 4:17 7:25, Ef 1:1 6:21, Cl 1:2, 7 4:7, 9, 1Tm 1:12, 2Tm 2:2, Hb 2:17 3:2, 5, 1Pe 5:12, Ap 2:13 19:11; of God, 1Co 1:9 10:13, 2Co 1:18, 1Ts 5:24, 2Ts 3:3, Hb 10:23 11:11, 2Tm 2:13, 1Jo 1:9, 1Pe 4:19; before ἐν, Lc 16:10-12 19:17, 1Tm 3:11; ἐπί, with accusative, Mt 25:23; ἄχρι θανάτου, Ap 2:10; ὁ μάρτυς ὁ π., Ap 1:5; id. καὶ ἀληθινός, Ap 3:14.
__2. Of things, trustworthy, reliable, sure: At 13:34, 1Tm 1:15 3:1 4:9, 2Tm 2:11, Tt 1:9 3:8, Ap 21:5 22:6.
__II. Act., believing, trusting, relying: At 16:1, 2Co 6:15, Gl 3:9, 1Tm 4:10 5:16 6:2, Tt 1:6, Ap 17:14; pl., At 10:45, 1Tm 4:3 4:12; opposite to ἄπιστος, Jo 20:27; π. εἰς θεόν, 1Pe 1:21; π. ποιεῖν, III Jn 5.
(On the difficulty of choosing in some cases between the active and the passive meaning, see Lft., Gal., 157.) †
(AS)

G4104.def:
πιστόω, -ῶ
(πιστός), [in LXX chiefly for אָמֵן ni. ;]
to make trustworthy (Thuc., 3Ki.1:36), hence, to establish (1Cr 17:14). Pass. and mid., to be assured of: with accusative of thing(s), 2Tm 3:14.†
(AS)

G4105.def:
πλανάω, -ῶ
(πλάνη), [in LXX chiefly for תָּעָה ;]
to cause to wander, lead astray. Pass., to go astray, wander: Mt 18:12-13 Hb 11:38, 1Pe 2:25 (cf. Is 53:6). Metaphorical, to lead astray, deceive: with accusative of person(s), Mt 24:4-5, 11 24:24, Mc 13:5-6, Jo 7:12, 2Tm 3:13; 1Jo 1:8 Jn 2:26 Jn 3:7, Ap 2:20 12:9 13:14 19:20 20:3, 8 20:10; pass., to be led astray, to err: Mt 22:29, Mc 12:24, 27, Lc 21:8, Jo 7:47, 2Tm 3:13, Tt 3:3, Hb 5:2, 2Pe 2:15, Ap 18:23; τ. καρδίᾳ, Hb 3:10; ἀπὸ τ. ἀληθείας, Tg 5:19;μὴ πλανᾶσθε, 1Co 6:9 15:33, Gl 6:7. Tg 1:16 (cf. ἀπο-πλανάω).†
(AS)

G4106.def:
πλάνη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: Pv 14:8 (מִרְמָה), Wis.1:12, al ;]
a wandering. Metaphorical, a going astray, an error (in NT always with respect to morals or religion): Mt 27:64, Rm 1:27, Ef 4:14, 1Ts 2:3, 2Ts 2:11, Tg 5:20, 2Pe 2:18 3:17 3:1-18; 1Jo 4:6, Ju 11.†
(AS)

G4107.def:
πλανήτης, -ου, ὁ
(πλανάω), [in LXX: Os 9:17 (נָדַד) * ;]
= πλάνης, a wanderer: ἀστέρες π. (cl. planets), wandering stars, Ju 13 (WH, mg., -τες).†
(AS)

G4108.def:
πλάνος, -ον
[in LXX: Jó 19:4 (מְשׁוּגָה), Jr 23:32 * ;]
__1. wandering.
__2. leading astray, deceiving: πνεύματα π., 1Tm 4:1. As subst., ὁ π., a deceiver, impostor: Mt 27:63, 2Co 6:8 6:1-18 2Jo 1:7.†
(AS)

G4109.def:
πλάξ, -ακός, ἡ
[in LXX for לוּחַ ;]
anything flat and broad.
__1. a plain (poët.).
__2. In late writers (Luc., al.), a flat stone, a tablet: 2Co 3:3, Hb 9:4.†
(AS)

G4110.def:
πλάσμα, -τος, τό
(πλάσσω), [in LXX chiefly for יֵצֶר ;]
that which is moulded or formed : Rm 9:20 (LXX).†
(AS)

G4111.def:
πλάσσω
[in LXX chiefly for יָצַר ;]
to form, mould: Rm 9:26 (LXX), 1Tm 2:13.†
(AS)

G4112.def:
πλαστός, -ή, -όν
(πλάσσω),
__1. formed, moulded (Hes., Plat., al.).
__2. Metaphorical, made up, fabricated, feigned (Hdt., Xen., al.): 2Pe 2:3.†
(AS)

G4114.def:
πλάτος, -ους, τό
[in LXX chiefly for רֹחַב ;]
breadth: Ef 3:18, Ap 21:16; τ. π. τῆς γῆς (Hc 1:6, מֶרְחָב), Ap 20:9.†
(AS)

G4115.def:
πλατύνω
(πλατύς), [in LXX chiefly for רָחַב hi. ;]
to make broad, enlarge, extend: with accusative of thing(s), Mt 23:5. Metaphorical (cf. Sl 119:32, al.), pass., ἡ καρδία, 2Co 6:11; ὑμεῖς, 2Co 6:13.†
(AS)

G4116.def:
πλατύς, -εῖα, -ύ
[in LXX for רָחָב ;]
broad: Mt 7:13. As subst., ἡ π. (sc. ὁδός),
[in LXX chiefly for רָחָב ;]
a street: Mt 6:5 12:19" (LXX), Mc 6:56, WH, mg., Lc 10:10 13:26 14:21, At 5:15, Ap 11:8 21:21 22:2.†
(AS)

G4117.def:
πλέγμα, -τος, τό
(πλέκω), [in Aq., Th.: Is 28:5 * ;]
what is woven or twisted (as basket-work, nets, etc.); a braiding (sc. τριχῶν, cf. 1Pe 3:3) : pl., 1Tm 2:9.†
(AS)

G4118.def:
πλεῖστος, πλείων, see: πολύς.
πολύς, πολλή, πολύ,
[in LXX chiefly for רַב and cognate forms ;]
__1. as adj., much, many, great, of number, space, degree, value, time, etc.: ἀριθμός, At 11:21; ὄχλος, Mc 5:24; θερισμός, Mt 9:37; χόρτος, Jo 6:10; χρόνος, Mt 25:19; γογγυσμός, Jo 7:12; πόνος, Cl 4:13; δόξα, Mt 24:30; σιγή, At 21:40; pl., προφῆται, Mt 13:17; ὄχλοι, Mt 4:25; δαιμόνια, Mc 1:34; δυνάμεις, Mt 7:22,
__2. As subst., pl. masc, πολλοί, many (persons): Mt 7:22, Mc 2:2, al.; with genitive partit., Mt 3:7, Lc 1:16, al.; before ἐκ, Jo 7:31, At 17:12; with art., οἱ π., the many, Mt 24:12, Rm 12:5, 1Co 10:17, 33 2Co 2:17; opposite to ὁ εἶς (Lft., Notes, 291), Rm 5:15, 19; neut. pl., πολλά: Mt 13:3, Mc 5:26, al.; accusative with adverbial force, Mc 1:45, Rm 16:6 (Deiss., LAE, 317), 1Co 16:12, Tg 3:2, al.; neut. sing., πολύ: Lc 12:48; adverbially, Mc 12:27, al.; πολλοῦ (genitive pret.), Mt 26:9; with compar. (Bl., §44, 5), π. σπουδαιότερον, 2Co 8:22; πολλῷ πλείους, Jo 4:41.
Compar., πλείων
, neut., πλεῖον and πλέον (see WH, App., 151), pl., πλείονες, -ας, -α, contr., πλείους, -ω (cf. Mayser, 69), more, greater;
__1. as adj.: Jo 15:2, At 18:2o, Hb 3:3; before παρά, Hb 11:4 (cf. Westc, in l. Was ΠΛΙΟΝΑ here a primitive error for ΗΔΙΟΝΑ ?); pi., At 13:31, al.; with genitive compar., Mt 21:36; with num. (ἤ of comp. omitted), At 4:22 24:11, al.
__2. As subst., οἱ π., the greater number: At 10:32 27:12, 1Co 10:5 15:6; also (Bl., §44, 3) others, more, the more: 2Co 2:6 4:15, Fp 1:14; πλείονα, Lc 11:53; πλειον, πλέον, Mt 20:10, 2Tm 3:9; with genitive comp., Mk 12:43, Lc 21:3; π. Ἰωνᾶ ὧδε, Mt 12:41; adverbially, At 4:17 20:9 24:4.
__3. As adv., πλεῖον: before ἤ, Lc 9:13; with genitive comp., Mt 5:20; πλείω: with num., Mt 26:53.
Superl., πλεῖστος, -η, -ον
, __(a) prop., most: Mt 11:20 21:8; adverbially, τὸ π., 1Co 14:27;
__(b) elative (M, Pr., 79), very great: ὄχλος π., Mc 4:1.
(AS)

G4119.def:
πλέον, see: πολύς.
πολύς, πολλή, πολύ,
[in LXX chiefly for רַב and cognate forms ;]
__1. as adj., much, many, great, of number, space, degree, value, time, etc.: ἀριθμός, At 11:21; ὄχλος, Mc 5:24; θερισμός, Mt 9:37; χόρτος, Jo 6:10; χρόνος, Mt 25:19; γογγυσμός, Jo 7:12; πόνος, Cl 4:13; δόξα, Mt 24:30; σιγή, At 21:40; pl., προφῆται, Mt 13:17; ὄχλοι, Mt 4:25; δαιμόνια, Mc 1:34; δυνάμεις, Mt 7:22,
__2. As subst., pl. masc, πολλοί, many (persons): Mt 7:22, Mc 2:2, al.; with genitive partit., Mt 3:7, Lc 1:16, al.; before ἐκ, Jo 7:31, At 17:12; with art., οἱ π., the many, Mt 24:12, Rm 12:5, 1Co 10:17, 33 2Co 2:17; opposite to ὁ εἶς (Lft., Notes, 291), Rm 5:15, 19; neut. pl., πολλά: Mt 13:3, Mc 5:26, al.; accusative with adverbial force, Mc 1:45, Rm 16:6 (Deiss., LAE, 317), 1Co 16:12, Tg 3:2, al.; neut. sing., πολύ: Lc 12:48; adverbially, Mc 12:27, al.; πολλοῦ (genitive pret.), Mt 26:9; with compar. (Bl., §44, 5), π. σπουδαιότερον, 2Co 8:22; πολλῷ πλείους, Jo 4:41.
Compar., πλείων
, neut., πλεῖον and πλέον (see WH, App., 151), pl., πλείονες, -ας, -α, contr., πλείους, -ω (cf. Mayser, 69), more, greater;
__1. as adj.: Jo 15:2, At 18:2o, Hb 3:3; before παρά, Hb 11:4 (cf. Westc, in l. Was ΠΛΙΟΝΑ here a primitive error for ΗΔΙΟΝΑ ?); pi., At 13:31, al.; with genitive compar., Mt 21:36; with num. (ἤ of comp. omitted), At 4:22 24:11, al.
__2. As subst., οἱ π., the greater number: At 10:32 27:12, 1Co 10:5 15:6; also (Bl., §44, 3) others, more, the more: 2Co 2:6 4:15, Fp 1:14; πλείονα, Lc 11:53; πλειον, πλέον, Mt 20:10, 2Tm 3:9; with genitive comp., Mk 12:43, Lc 21:3; π. Ἰωνᾶ ὧδε, Mt 12:41; adverbially, At 4:17 20:9 24:4.
__3. As adv., πλεῖον: before ἤ, Lc 9:13; with genitive comp., Mt 5:20; πλείω: with num., Mt 26:53.
Superl., πλεῖστος, -η, -ον
, __(a) prop., most: Mt 11:20 21:8; adverbially, τὸ π., 1Co 14:27;
__(b) elative (M, Pr., 79), very great: ὄχλος π., Mc 4:1.
(AS)

G4120.def:
πλέκω
[in LXX: Êx 28:14 (עֲבֹת), Is 28:5 (צְפִירָה)* ;]
to plait, twist, weave: Mt 27:29, Mc 15:17, Jo 19:2.†
(AS)

G4121.def:
πλεονάζω
(πλέον), [in LXX for עֲדַף, רָבָה, etc. ;]
__I. Intrans.
__1. Of persons;
__(a) to abound in (Arist.);
__(b) to superabound: 2Co 8:15 (LXX).
__2. Of things, to abound, superabound: Rm 5:20 6:1, 2Co 4:15, Fp 4:17, 2Ts 1:3, 2Pe 1:8.
__II. Trans. (Nm 26:54, Sl 71:21; not cl, see Lft., Notes, 48 f.), to make to abound: 1Ts 3:12 (cf. ὑπερ-πλεονάζω).†
SYN.: περισσεύω, q.v (AS)

G4122.def:
πλεονεκτέω, -ῶ
(πλεονέκτης, which see), [in LXX: Hc 2:9, Eze.22:27 (בָּצַע), Jz 4:11 B* ;]
__1. intrans., to have more, to have an advantage (cl., with genitive of person(s)).
__2. Trans., in late writers (see M, Pr., 65), to over­reach, defraud: with accusative of person(s), 2Co 7:2 12:17-18; ἐν τ. πράγματιι, 1Ts 4:6 (see M, Th., in l); pass., 2Co 2:11 (as also in cl.; see LS, see word).†
(AS)

G4123.def:
πλεονέκτης, -ου, ὁ
(πλέον, ἔχω), [in LXX: Sir.14:9 * ;]
= ὁ θέλων πλέον ἔχειν (see MM, xx),
one desirous of having more, covetous: 1Co 5:10-11 6:10 Ef 5:5.†
(AS)

G4124.def:
πλεονεξία, -ας, ἡ
(πλεονέκτης), [in LXX for בֶּצַע ;]
the character and conduct of a πλεονέκτης.
__1. advantage.
__2. desire for advantage, grasping, aggression, cupidity, covetousness: Lc 12:15, Rm 1:29, 2Co 9:5, Ef 4:19 (see ICC, in l) Ef 5:3, Cl 3:5, 1Ts 2:5, 2Pe 2:3 2:14; pl. (see Bl., § 32, 6), Mc 7:22.†
SYN.: φιλαργυρία, avarice (see Tr., Syn., § xxiv) (AS)

G4125.def:
πλευρά, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX (frequently pl. as in Hom.) chiefly for צֵלָע ;]
the side: Mt 27:49 ([[WH]] R, mg.), Jo 19:34 20:20, 25 20:27 At 12:7.†
(AS)

G4126.def:
πλέω
[in LXX, before εἰς, Jn 1:3 (בּוֹא), I Et 4:23, Is 42:10; before ἐπί, 4Ma.7:3; with accusative (poët.), Sir.43:24, 1Ma.13:29 (cf. At 27:2, Rec.) * ;]
to sail: Lc 8:23, At 27:24; before εἰς, At 21:3 27:2, 6; ἐπί, Ap 18:17
(cf. ἀπό-, δια-, ἐκ-, κατα-, παρα-, ὑπο-πλέω).†
(AS)

G4127.def:
πληγή, ῆς, ἡ
(πλήσσω), [in LXX chiefly for מַכָּה, also for מַגֵּפָה etc. ;]
__1. a blow, stripe, wound: pl., Lc 10:30 12:48, At 16:23, 33, 2Co 6:5 11:23; ἡ π. τ. θανάτου (RV, death-stroke), Ap 13:3, 12; τ. μαχαίρας, Ap 13:14.
__2. Metaphorical, a calamity, plague: Ap 9:18, 20 11:6 15:1, 6 15:8 16:9, 21 18:4, 8 21:9 22:18.†
(AS)

G4128.def:
πλῆθος, -ους, τό
[in LXX chiefly for רֹב, also for הָמוֹן, etc. ;]
__1. a great number, a multitude;
__(a) of things : ἰχθύων, Lc 5:6, Jo 21:6; φρυγάνων, At 28:3; ἁμαρτιίῶν, Tg 5:20, 1Pe 4:8; τ. πλήθει, in multitude, Hb 11:12;
__(b) of persons: At 21:22 (WH, R, om.); with genitive, Lc 2:13, Jo 5:3, At 5:14; π. πολύ (πολὺ π.), Mc 3:7-8; id. with genitive, Lc 6:17 23:27, At 14:1 17:4
__2. Of persons, with art., the whole number, the multitude (in Plat., Thuc., Xen., al., = δῆμος, the commons, or-opposite to δῆμος-the populace) : At 2:6 15:30 19:9 23:7; τ. λαοῦ, At 21:36; τ. πόλεως, At 14:4; πᾶν τὸ π., At 15:12; with genitive, Lc 1:10 8:37 19:37 23:1, At 4:32 5:16 6:2, 5 25:24.†
(AS)

G4129.def:
πληθύνω
(causal of πληθύω, to be full, πληθύς, Ion. for πλῆθος), [in LXX chiefly for רָבָה hi. ;]
__1. trans., to increase, multiply: 2Co 9:10 6:14" (LXX) ; pass., to be increased, to multiply: Mt 24:12, At 6:7 7:17 9:31 12:24; with dative of person(s) (Dan LXX TH 3:31(98) al.), 1Pe 1:2, 2Pe 1:2, Ju 2.
__2. Intrans., to be increased, to multiply: At 6:1.†
(AS)

G4130.def:
πίμπλημι
[in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא, also for שָׂבַע ;]
trans. form in present and imperfect of πλήθω (intrans. in these tenses), which supplies the other tense forms;
to fill: with accusative, Lc 5:7; with accusative and genitive, Mt 27:48; pass., Mt 22:10, At 19:29; of that which fills or takes possession of the mind : pass., with genitive, Lc 1:15, 41 1:67 4:28 5:26 6:11, At 2:4 3:10 4:8, 31 5:17 9:17 13:9, 45. Metaphorical (as in LXX for מָלֵא: Gn 29:27, Jó 15:32), to complete, fulfil: pass., of prophecy, Lc 21:22; of time, Lc 1:23, 57 2:6, 21-22 (cf. ἐμ-πίμπλημι).†
πλήθω, see: πίμπλημι
SYN.: πληροφορέω, πληρόω (AS)

G4131.def:
πλήκτης, -ου, ὁ
(πλήσσω), [in Sm.: Sl 35:15 * ;]
a striker, brawler: 1Tm 3:3, Tt 1:7 (Arist., Plut., al.).†
(AS)

G4132.def:
πλήμμυρα, -ης (for Att.. -ας, see Bl., § 7, 1)
(πλήθω), [in LXX: π. γένεσθαι, Jó 40:18 (23) (נָהָר עָשַׁק) * ;]
a flood (of sea or river) : Lc 6:48.†
(AS)

G4133.def:
πλήν
adv., [in LXX for רַק, בַּד, אַךְ, etc. ;]
__1. introducing a clause (= ἀλλά, δέ; "it is obvious that πλήν was the regular word in the vulgar language": Bl., § 77, 13), yet, howbeit, only: Mt 11:22, 24 18:7 26:39, 64 (M, Pr., 86), Lc 6:24, 35 10:11, 14 10:20 11:41 12:31 13:33 17:1 18:8 19:27 22:21-22, 42 (WH, mg. om.) Lc 23:28, 1Co 11:11, Ef 5:33, Fp 3:16 4:14, Ap 2:25; π. ὅτι (Hdt., Plat., al.), except that, save that, At 20:23, Fp 1:18.
__2. As prep., with genitive, except, save (cl.) : Mc 12:32, Jo 8:10, At 8:1 15:28 27:22.†
(AS)

G4134.def:
πλήρης, -ες
[in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא ;]
__1. full, filled: Mt 14:20 15:37; with genitive of thing(s), Mc 8:19; λέπρας, Lc 5:12; metaphorically, of the soul: πνεύματος ἀγίου, Lc 4:1, At 6:3 7:55 11:24; πίστεως, At 6:5; χάριτος, ib. At 6:8; χ. καὶ ἀληθείας (where π. is indecl.; see M, Pr., 50; Milligan, NTD, 65, with reff. in each), Jo 1:14; δόλου, At 13:10; θυμοῦ, At 19:28; ἔργων ἀγαθῶν, At 9:36.
__2. full, complete: μισθός, II Jn 8; σῖτος (π. prob. in­decl. here; see on Jo 1:14, supr.), Mc 4:28.†
(AS)

G4135.def:
πληροφορέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Ec 8:11 (מָלֵא) * ;]
__1. to bring in full measure, hence, to fulfil, accomplish: Lc 1:1, 2Tm 4:5 4:17.
__2. to persuade, assure or satisfy fully (so in π.; see Deiss., LAE, 82 f.; M, Th., 9): pass., Rm 4:21 14:5, Cl 4:12 (see Lft., in l).
__3. to fill: Rm 15:13, L, mg. (Cl. Ro., 1Co 5:4); metaphorically, pass., to be filled with, hence, fully bent on (Ec, l.with).†
(AS)

G4136.def:
πληροφορία, -ας, ἡ
(πληροφορέω),
full assurance, confidence: 1Ts 1:5; τ. συνέσεως, Cl 2:2; τ. ἐλπίδος, Hb 6:11; πίστεως, Hb 10:22 (cf. Lft. on Col., l.with; M, Th., 9).†
(AS)

G4137.def:
πληρόω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא ;]
__1. to fill, make full, fill to the full, with accusative;
__(a) of things : pass. (σαψήνη, φάραγξ), Mt 13:48, Lc 3:5" (LXX) ; figuratively, Mt 23:32; but chiefly of immaterial things: πᾶσαν χρείαν, Fp 4:19; ἦχος ἐλήρωσε τ. οἶκον, At 2:2; with genitive of thing(s) (cl.), At 5:28; pass., before ἐκ, Jo 12:3 (cf. B1., § 36, 4); π. τ. καρδίαν, Jo 16:6, At 5:3; metaphorically, of the all-pervading activity of Christ, Ef 4:10; mid., Ef 1:23;
__(b) of persons: to fill with, cause to abound in : with genitive of thing(s) (cl.), At 2:28 (LXX), Rm 15:13; pass., to be filled with, abound in: Ef 3:19, Fp 4:18; with genitive of thing(s) (cl.), At 13:52, Rm 15:14, 2Tm 1:4; with dative (Æsch., al.), Lc 2:40 (with genitive, T), Rm 1:29, 2Co 7:4; with accusative (so in π., see MM, xx), Fp 1:11, Cl 1:9; before ἐν, Ef 5:18, Cl 2:10.
__2. to complete;
__(a) to complete, fulfil: of number, Ap 6:11, WH, tat.; of time (MM, xx), Mc 1:15, Lc 21:24, Jo 7:8, At 7:23, 30 9:23 24:27; ἐυδοκίαν, 2Ts 1:11; τ. χαράν, Fp 2:2; pass., Jo 3:29 15:11 16:24 17:13, 1Jo 1:4, 2Jn.12; τ. ἔργα, Ap 3:2; ἡ ὑπακυή, 2Co 10:6; τ. πάσχα, Lc 22:16;
__(b) to execute, accomplish, carry out to the full: Mt 3:15, Lc 7:1 9:31, At 12:25 13:25 14:26 19:21, Rm 8:4 13:8 15:19, Gl 5:14, Cl 1:25 4:17, Ap 6:11, T, WH, R, mg.;
__(with) of sayings, prophecies, etc., to bring to pass, fulfil: Mt 1:22 2:15, 17 2:23 4:14 5:17 8:17 12:17 13:35 21:4 26:54, 56 27:9, Mc 14:49 15:28 (WH, R, txt. om.), Lc 1:20 4:21 24:44, Jo 12:38 13:18 15:25 17:12 18:9, 32 19:24, 36, At 1:16 3:18 13:27, Tg 2:23 (cf. Lft., Col., 255 ff.).†
(AS)

G4138.def:
πλήρωμα, -τος, τό
(πληρόω), [in LXX for מְלֹא ;]
the result of the action involved in πληρόω (Lft., Col., 255 if.; AR, Eph., 255 ff.), hence,
__1. in passive sense, that which has been completed, complement, plenitude, fullness (in Xen., Luc., Polyb., al., of a ship's crew or cargo, and by meton. of the ship itself) : Jo 1:16, Rm 11:12, 25 15:29, 1Co 10:26" (LXX) Ef 1:23 (AR, 42 ff.) Ef 3:19 (AR. 87 ff.) Ef 4:13, Cl 1:19 2:9; of time, Gl 4:4, Ef 1:10; κοφίνων (σφυρίδων) πληρώματα, basketfuls, Mc 6:43 8:20.
__2. In active sense (= πλήρωσις, as frequently in words of these formations, cf. κτίσις, and see MM, xx);
__(a) that which fills up (but see Lft., l.with) : Mt 9:16, Mc 2:21;
__(b) a filling up, completing, fulfilment: Rm 13:10.†
(AS)

G4139.def:
πλησίος, -α, -ον
(πέλας, near),
near, close by, neighbouring. As adv., πλησίον = πέλας, near: with genitive, Jo 4:5; with art., ὁ π., one's neigh­bour
[in LXX chiefly for רֵעַ ]:
Lc 10:29, 36, At 7:27, Rm 13:10 15:2, Ef 4:25, Tg 4:12; ἀγαπήσεις τὸν π. σου ὡς σεαυτόν (Lv 19:18, LXX), Mt 5:43 19:19 22:39, Mc 12:31, 33, Lc 10:27, Rm 13:9, Gl 5:14, Tg 2:8 (on the various senses of ὁ π. in OT, NT, see DB, iii, 511; DCC, ii, 240 f.).†
(AS)

G4140.def:
πλησμονή, -ῆς, ἡ
(πίμπλημι), [in LXX chiefly for שָׂבֵעַ and cognate forms ;]
a filling up, satiety: πρὸς π. σαρκός (RV, against the indulgence of the flesh; but ICC, in l, for the full satisfaction of the flesh, op. cit., 276 ff.), Cl 2:23.†
(AS)

G4141.def:
πλήσσω
[in LXX chiefly for נָכָה hi., ho. ;]
to strike, smite: pass., Ap 8:12 (cf. ἐπι, πλήσσω).†
(AS)

G4142.def:
πλοιάριον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of πλοῖον),
a boat: Mc 3:9, Lc 5:2 (πλοῖα, WH, txt., R), Jo 6:22-23 (πλοῖα, WH) Jo 6:24 21:8.†
(AS)

G4143.def:
πλοῖον, -ον, τό
(πλέω), [in LXX chiefly for אֳנִיָּה ;]
a boat, also (= obsolete ναῦς) a ship: Mt 4:21-22, and frequently in Gosp. and Ac, Tg 3:4, Ap 8:9 18:19.
(AS)

G4144.def:
πλόος, πλούς genitive, -όου, -oῦ (and in late writers also πλοός, like νοός from νοῦς), ὁ
(πλέω), [in LXX: Wis.14:1 * ;]
a voyage: At 21:7 27:9-10.†
(AS)

G4145.def:
πλούσιος, -α, -ον
(πλοῦτος), [in LXX chiefly for עָשִׁיר ;]
rich, wealthy: Mt 27:57, Lc 12:16 14:12 16:1, 19 18:23 19:2. Substantively, ὁ π., Lc 16:21-22, Tg 1:10-11; oἱ π., Lc 6:24 21:1, 1Tm 6:17, Tg 2:6 5:1, Ap 6:15 13:16; anarth., a rich man, Mt 19:23-24, Mc 10:25 12:41, Lc 18:25. Metaphorical, of God, ἐν ἐλέει (= cl., with genitive, dative), Ef 2:4; of Christ, 2Co 8:9; of Christians, Ap 2:9 3:17; ἐν πίστει, Tg 2:5.†
(AS)

G4147.def:
πλουτέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for עָשַׁר hi. ;]
to be rich, aor., to become rich: Lc 1:53, 1Tm 6:9; before ἀπό (Sir.11:18), Ap 18:15; ἐκ, Ap 18:3, 19; ἐν (= cl., with genitive, dative, accusative, cf. πλούσιος), 1Tm 6:18. Metaphorical, π. εἰς θεόν, Lc 12:21; of God, εἰς πάντας, Rm 10:12; aor., I became rich, 1Co 4:8, 2Co 8:9, Ap 3:18; pf., I have become rich, Ap 3:17.†
(AS)

G4148.def:
πλουτίζω
(πλοῦτος), [in LXX chiefly for עָשַׁר hi. ;]
to make rich, enrich: with accusative of person(s), pass., 2Co 9:11. Metaphorical, of spiritual riches, with accusative: of person(s), 2Co 6:10; before ἐν, pass., 1Co 1:5.†
(AS)

G4149.def:
πλοῦτος, -ου, ὁ and (in 2Co 8:2, Ef 1:17 2:7 3:8, 16, Fp 4:19, Cl 1:27 2:2; see WH, App., 158; M, Pr., 60) τό,
[in LXX chiefly for עֹשֶׁר ;]
riches, wealth: of external possessions, Mt 13:22, Mc 4:19, Lc 8:14, 1Tm 6:17, Tg 5:2, Ap 18:16; of moral and spiritual conceptions, Rm 2:4 9:23 11:12, 33, 2Co 8:2, Ef 1:7, 18 2:7 3:8, 16 Fp 4:19, Cl 1:27 2:2, Hb 11:26, Ap 5:12.†
(AS)

G4150.def:
πλύνω
[in LXX chiefly for כָּבַס pi. ;]
to wash (inanimate objects, esp. clothing): τ. δίκτυα, Lc 5:2. Fig., τ. στολάς, Ap 7:14 22:14 (cf. Sl 51:4, 9 and see: ἀπο-πλύνω).†
SYN.: see: λούω (AS)

G4151G.def:
πνεῦμα, -τος, τό,
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for רוּחַ ;]
__1. of air in motion;
__(a) wind: Jo 3:8; pl., Hb 1:7 (LXX);
__(b) breath: π. ζωῆς, Ap 11:11; π. τοῦ στόματος, figuratively, 2Ts 2:8 (cf. Ps 32 (33)6).
__2. Of the vital principle, the spirit (Arist., Polyb., al.): Lc 8:55, Jo 19:30, At 7:59, al.; opposite to σάρξ, Mt 26:41, Mc 14:38, 1Co 5:5, al.; to σῶμα, Rm 8:10, 1Co 6:17 7:34, 1Pe 4:6; to ψυχή, Fp 1:27, Hb 4:12; τὸ π. καὶ ἡ ψ. καὶ τ. σῶμα, 1Ts 5:23 (M, Th., in l.); dative, τῷ π., in spirit, Mc 2:8 8:12, Jo 11:33 13:21, At 18:25, Rm 12:11, 1Co 7:34, 1Pe 3:18, al.; of the human spirit of Christ, Rm 1:4, 1Tm 3:16.
__3. spirit, i.e. frame of mind, disposition, influence: Lc 1:17, Rm 8:15, 1Co 4:21, Gal 6:1, Ef 2:2, 2Tm 1:7, 1Jo 4:6, al.
__4. An incorporeal being, a spirit: Lc 24:37, 39 At 23:8; π. ὁ θεός, God is spirit, Jo 4:24; πατὴρ τῶν π., Hb 12:9; of disembodied human beings, Hb 12:23, 1Pe 3:19 (ICC, in l.; DB, iii, 795); of angels. Hb 1:14; of demons or evil spirits, Mt 8:16, Mc 9:20, Lc 9:39, al.; π. πύθυωνα, At 16:16; πνεύματα δαιμονίων, Ap 16:14; π. δαιμονίου ἀκαθάρτου, Lc 4:33; π. ἀσθενείας (Bl., §35, 5), Lc 13:11; π. ἀκάθαρτον, Mt 10:1, Mc 1:23, Lc 4:36, At 5:16; π. ἄλαλον (καὶ κωφόν), Mc 9:17, 25; πονηρόν, Lc 7:21, At 19:12, al.
__5. Of the Holy Spirit, π. ἅγιον, τὸ ἅ. π., τὸ π. τὸ ἅ. τὸ π., π. (the article as a rule being used when the Spirit is regarded as a Person or a Divine Power, and omitted when the reference is to an operation, influence or gift of the Spirit; see WM, 151:5; Bl., §46, 7): anarth., Mt 1:18 3:11, 16 4:1, Mc 1:8 (Swete, in l.), ib.10, Lc 1:15, Jo 7:39, At 19:2, Rm 5:5, 1Co 2:4, al.; with art., Mt 4:1 12:31, 32 Mc 1:10 3:29, Lc 2:26, Jo 7:36 14:26, At 4:31 5:3, Rm 8:16, al.; (τὸ) π. (τοῦ) θεοῦ, Mt 3:16, Rm 8:9, Ef 3:16, 1Jo 4:2, al.; τὸ π. τ. πατρός, Mt 10:20; π. θεοῦ ζῶντος, 2Co 3:3; (τὸ) π. τοῦ κυρίου, Lc 4:18, At 5:9 8:39; τὸ π. Ἰησοῦ, At 16:7; Χριστοῦ, Rm 8:9; Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, Fp 1:19; τὸ π. τ. ἀληθείας, Jo 15:26 16:13, 1Jo 4:6; λείγει (μαρτυρεῖ) τὸ π. (τὸ ἅγιον), At 21:11 28:25, 1Tm 4:1, Hb 3:7 10:15, Ap 14:13; before τ. ἐκκλησίαις, Ap 2:7, 11 17, 29, 3:6, 12, 22; ἐν τ. π., Lc 2:27; κατὰ πνεῦμα, Rm 8:4, 5; ἐξ ὕδατος καὶ π., Jo 3:5, διὰ πνεύματος αἰωνίου, Hb 9:14; ἐν ἁγιασμῷ πνεύματος, 2Ts 2:13, 1Pe 1:2; ἓν π., 1Co 12:13, Ef 2:18 4:4; ὁ δὲ κύριος τὸ π. ἐστιν, 2Co 3:17; of that which is effected or governed by the Spirit, opposite to γράμμα, Rm 2:29 7:6, 2Co 3:6.
SYN.: νοῦς, which in NT is contrasted with π. as "the action of the understanding in man with that of the spiritual or ecstatic impulse" (DB, iv, 612); ψυχή — the usual term in cl. psychology—in NT, "expresses man as apart from God, a separate individual, π. expresses man as drawing his life from God" (DB, 1-vol., 872). (AS)

G4152.def:
πνευματικός, -ή, -όν
(πνεῦμα),
__1. of or caused by the wind, air or breath (Arist., al.).
__2. spiritual (opposite to σωματικός, Plut.);
__(a) of created beings : τὰ π. (RV, the spiritual hosts), Ef 6:12; of that which is related to the human spirit, opposite to ψυχικός, 1Co 15:44 15:46;
__(b) of that which belongs to or is actuated by the Divine Spirit;
__α of persons : 1Co 2:15 3:1 14:37, Gl 6:1; οἶκος π., figuratively, 1Pe 2:5;
__β of things : Rm 1:11 7:14, 1Co 2:13 10:3-4 12:1 14:1, Ef 1:3 5:19, Cl 1:9 3:16, 1Pe 2:5; opposite to τ. σαρκικά, Rm 15:27, 1Co 9:11.†
SYN.: ψυχικός, which see, and cf. DB, ii, 410, iv, 612 (AS)

G4153.def:
πνευματικῶς
adv. (πνεῦμα),
spiritually;
__(a) by the aid of the Holy Spirit: 1Co 2:13 (WH, mg.), 1Co 2:14;
__(b) in a spiritual sense : Ap 11:8.†
(AS)

G4154.def:
πνέω
[in LXX: Sl 147:7 (18) (נָשַׁב hi.), Is 40:24 (נָשַׁף), Sir.43:16, 20, Ep. Je 61, 2Ma.9:7 * ;]
to breathe, blow: of the wind, Mt 7:25, 27, Lc 12:55, Jo 3:8 6:18, Ap 7:1; ηῇ πνεούσῃ (sc. αὔρᾳ), At 27:40 (cf. ἐκ-, ἐν-, ὑπο-πνέω).†
αὔρα, a breeze : τ. πνεούσῇ (sc. αὔρᾳ), At 27:40.†
(AS)

G4155.def:
πνίγω
[in LXX: 1Rs 16:14-15 (בָּעַת pi.) * ;]
to choke: with accusative, Mt 13:7 (WH, mg.); imperfect (coniative), Mt 18:28; of drowning, pass., Mc 5:13 (cf. ἀπο-, ἐπι-, συν-πνίγω).†
(AS)

G4157.def:
πνοή, -ῆς, ή
(πνέω), [in LXX chiefly for נְשָׁמָה ;]
__1. a blowing, blast, wind: At 2:2.
__2. a breathing, breath: At 17:25 (Gn 2:7, al.).†
(AS)

G4158.def:
ποδήρης, -ες
(πούς), [in LXX: Êx 25:6 (7) Êx 35:9 (חֹשֶׁן), Êx 28:4 Êx 29:5 (מְעִיל), Êx 28:27 (31) (אֵפוֹד), אֵפוֹד), Eze.9:2-3, 11 (בַּד), Zc 3:5 (4) (מַחֲלָצָה), Wis.18:24, Sir.27:8 45:8 * ;]
reaching to the feet. of a garment (sc. χιτών, cf. Ex, Ez, ll. with; Xen., al.), Ap 1:13 (for -η, LT7 read -ην; see M, Pr., 49).†
SYN.: στολή, see Tr., Syn., § 1 (AS)

G4159.def:
πόθεν
adv.,
whence;
__(a) of place: Mt 15:33, Lc 13:25, 27, Jo 3:8 6:5 8:14 9:29-30 19:9, Ap 7:13; metaphorically, of condition, Ap 2:5;
__(b) of origin: Mt 13:27, 54 13:56 21:25, Mc 6:2, Lc 20:7, Jo 2:9, Tg 4:1; of parentage, Jo 7:27-28;
__(with) of cause: Mc 8:4 12:37, Lc 1:43, Jo 1:49 4:11.†
(AS)

G4160G.def:
ποιέω, -ῶ,
[in LXX for a great variety of words, but chiefly for עשׂה ;]

__2. to do, perform, carry out, execute: absol., with adv., καλῶς π., Mt 12:12, 1Co 7:37, 38 Tg 2:19; id. before ptcp. G4161.def:
ποίημα, -τος, τό
(ποιέω), [in LXX chiefly for מַעֲשֶׂה (frequently in Ec) ;]
that which is made or done, a work: Rm 1:20, Ef 2:10.†
(AS)

G4163.def:
ποιητής, -οῦ ὁ
(ποιέω), [in LXX: 1Ma.2:67 * ;]
in cl.,
__1. a maker, author.
__2. Esp., a poet: At 17:28. Later,
__3. a doer: τ. νόμου, Rm 2:13, Tg 4:11 (1Mac, l.with); ἔργου, Tg 1:25; λόγου, ib. Tg 1:22-23.†
(AS)

G4164.def:
ποικίλος, -η, -ον
[in LXX for נָקֹד, רִקְמָה, etc. ;]
many-coloured, variegated. Metaphorical, various, manifold: Mt 4:24, Mc 1:34, Lc 4:40, 2Tm 3:6, Tt 3:3, Hb 2:4 13:9, Tg 1:2, 1Pe 1:6 4:10.†
(AS)

G4165.def:
ποιμαίνω
(ποιμήν), [in LXX chiefly for רָעָה ;]
to act as shepherd, tend flocks: Lc 17:7; with accusative, ποιμνην, 1Co 9:7. Metaphorical, to tend, shepherd, govern: with accusative, Mt 2:6 (LXX), Jo 21:16, At 20:28, 1Pe 5:2, Ju 12, Ap 2:27 7:17 12:5 19:15.†
SYN.: βόσκω, q.v (AS)

G4166.def:
ποιμήν, -ίνος, ὁ
[in LXX for רָעָה ;]
a shepherd: Mt 9:36 25:32 26:31" (LXX), Mc 6:34 14:27, Lc 2:8, 15 2:18, 20 Jo 10:2, 12 Metaphorical, of Christ; Jo 10:11, 14 10:16 Hb 13:20, 1Pe 2:25; of Christian pastors, Ef 4:11 (cf. Hom., Il, i, 263, ποιμένα λαῶν).†
(AS)

G4167.def:
ποίμνη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: Gn 32:16 (17) (עֵדֶר), Zc 13:7 A * ;]
a flock, prop., of sheep: Mt 26:31, Lc 2:8, 1Co 9:7. Metaphorical, of Christ's followers, Jo 10:16.†
(AS)

G4168.def:
ποίμνιον, -ου, τό, = ποίμνη, which see
[in LXX chiefly for צֹאן, also for עֵדֶר, etc. ;]
a flock, prop., of sheep. Metaphorical, of Christians: Lc 12:32, At 20:23, 28, 1Pe 5:3; τ. θεοῦ, ib. 1Pe 5:2.†
(AS)

G4169.def:
ποῖος, -α, -ον
interrog. pronom. adj. (corresponding to the demonstr. τοῖος and the relat. οἷος), [in LXX chiefly for זֶה אֵי־ ;]
of what quality or sort: absol., n. pl., Lc 24:19; with subst.;
__(a) prop., in direct questions: Mt 19:18 21:23 22:36 24:42, Mc 11:28 12:28, Lc 6:32-34, Jo 10:32, At 4:7 7:49, Rm 3:27, 1Co 15:35, Tg 4:14 (but see: ποία), 1Pe 2:20;
__(b) in indirect questions = ὁποῖος : Mt 21:24, 27 24:43, Mc 11:29, 33, Lc 12:39 20:2, 8, Jo 12:33 18:32 21:19 At 23:34, 1Pe 1:11, Ap 3:3; ποῖας (sc. ὁδοῦ), Lc 5:19.†
(AS)

G4170.def:
πολεμέω, -ῶ
(πόλεμος), [in LXX chiefly for לָחַם ni. ;]
to make war, fight: Ap 12:7 b Ap 19:11; before μετά (2Rs 21:15 and see M, Pr., 106, 247), Ap 2:16 12:7 a Ap 13:4 17:14; hyperb., of private quarrels, Tg 4:2.†
(AS)

G4171.def:
πόλεμος, -ον, ό
[in LXX chiefly for מִלְחָמָה ;]
__1. war: Mt 24:6, Mc 13:7, Lc 14:31 21:9, Hb 11:34; π. ποιεῖν, before μετά, with genitive (cf. πολεμέω), Ap 11:7 12:17 13:7 19:19.
__2. = μάχη, a fight, battle: 1Co 14:8, Ap 9:7, 9 12:7 16:14 20:8; hyperb., of private quarrels (cf. πολεμέω), Tg 4:1.†
(AS)

G4172.def:
πόλις, -εως, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for עִיר ;]
a city: Mt 2:23, Mc 1:45, Lc 4:29, Jo 4:8, al. mult.; opposite to κῶμαι (κ. καὶ ἀγροί), Mt 9:35 10:11, Mc 6:56, Lc 8:1 13:22; with nom. propr. in appos. (cl.), At 11:5 16:14; with id. in genitive appos. (BL, §35, 5), At 8:5, 2Pe 2:6; genitive, of the region, Lc 1:26 4:31, Jo 4:5; of the inhabitants, Mt 10:5, 23 Lc 23:51, At 19:35, 2Co 11:32; with genitive of person(s), of one's residence or native place, Mt 22:7, Lc 2:4, 11 4:29 10:11, Jo 1:45, At 16:20, Ap 16:9; of Jerusalem: ἡ ἁγία π., Mt 4:5 27:53, Ap 11:2; ἡ ἠγαπημένη, Ap 20:19; π. τοῦ μεγάλου, Mt 5 ̈35 (cf. Ps 47 (48):2); of the heavenly city in the Apocalyptic visions, Ap 3:12 21:2, 10 14ff. 22:14, 19. By meton., of the inhabitants of a city: Mt 8:34 12:25 21:10, Mc 1:33, At 14:21 21:30.
(AS)

G4173.def:
πολιτάρχης, -ου, ὁ
= πολίαρχος (Pind., Eur.),
the ruler of a city, a politarch: At 17:6, 8 (see MM, xx).†
(AS)

G4174.def:
πολιτεία, -ας, ἡ
(πολιτεύω), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:11 2Mac 6:23 2Mac 8:17 2Mac 13:14, 3Ma.3:21 3Mac 3:23, 4Ma.3:20 4Mac 8:7 4Mac 17:9 * ;]
__1. citizenship: At 22:28 (3 Mac, ll. with, Hdt., Xen., a1.).
__2. government, administration (Aristoph., Dem., al.).
__3. a commonwealth: Ef 2:12.†
(AS)

G4175.def:
πολίτευμα, -τος, τό
(πολιτεύω), [in LXX: 2Ma.12:7 * ;]
__1. an act of administration.
__2. a form of government.
__3. = πολιτεία,
__(a) citizenship : Fp 3:20 (R, txt.);
__(b) community, commonwealth : Phi, l.with (R, mg.; for exx, see MM, xx).†
(AS)

G4176.def:
πολιτεύω more frequently as depon., -ομαι, and so in LXX and NT
(πολίτης), [in LXX: Et 8:13, 2Ma.6:1 2Mac 11:25, 3Ma.3:4 3Mac 3:1-30; 4Ma.4:1-26 * ;]
to be a citizen, live as a citizen: metaphorically, of conduct as based on heavenly citizenship, At 23:1, Fp 1:27.†
(AS)

G4177.def:
πολίτης, -ου, ὁ
(πόλις), [in LXX chiefly for רֵעַ ;]
__1. a citizen: with genitive loc., Lc 15:15, At 21:39.
__2. a fellow-citizen: with genitive of person(s), Lc 19:14, Hb 8:11" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G4179.def:
πολλαπλασίων, -ον
(πόλυς),
= πολλαπλάσιος,
many times more: Mt 19:29, Lc 18:30.†
ἑπταπλασίων, -ον,
genitive, -ονος,
[in LXX for שִׁבְעָתַיִם, Sl 79:12, al. ;]
sevenfold: Lc 18:30 (WH, mg., for πολλαπλ- WH, txt., RV; see WH, Notes, 62).†
(AS)

G4180.def:
πολυλογία, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX: Pv 10:19 (דָּבָר רֹב)* ;]
much speaking, loquacity: Mt 6:7.†
(AS)

G4181.def:
πολυμερῶς
adv. (πολύς, μέρος),
in many parts or portions: Hb 1:1 (Plut., al.).†
(AS)

G4182.def:
πολυ-ποίκιλος, -ον
__1. much variegated, of greatly differing colours (Eur.).
__2. manifold: Ef 3:10.†
(AS)

G4183.def:
πολύς, πολλή, πολύ,
[in LXX chiefly for רַב and cognate forms ;]
__1. as adj., much, many, great, of number, space, degree, value, time, etc.: ἀριθμός, At 11:21; ὄχλος, Mc 5:24; θερισμός, Mt 9:37; χόρτος, Jo 6:10; χρόνος, Mt 25:19; γογγυσμός, Jo 7:12; πόνος, Cl 4:13; δόξα, Mt 24:30; σιγή, At 21:40; pl., προφῆται, Mt 13:17; ὄχλοι, Mt 4:25; δαιμόνια, Mc 1:34; δυνάμεις, Mt 7:22,
__2. As subst., pl. masc, πολλοί, many (persons): Mt 7:22, Mc 2:2, al.; with genitive partit., Mt 3:7, Lc 1:16, al.; before ἐκ, Jo 7:31, At 17:12; with art., οἱ π., the many, Mt 24:12, Rm 12:5, 1Co 10:17, 33 2Co 2:17; opposite to ὁ εἶς (Lft., Notes, 291), Rm 5:15, 19; neut. pl., πολλά: Mt 13:3, Mc 5:26, al.; accusative with adverbial force, Mc 1:45, Rm 16:6 (Deiss., LAE, 317), 1Co 16:12, Tg 3:2, al.; neut. sing., πολύ: Lc 12:48; adverbially, Mc 12:27, al.; πολλοῦ (genitive pret.), Mt 26:9; with compar. (Bl., §44, 5), π. σπουδαιότερον, 2Co 8:22; πολλῷ πλείους, Jo 4:41.
Compar., πλείων
, neut., πλεῖον and πλέον (see WH, App., 151), pl., πλείονες, -ας, -α, contr., πλείους, -ω (cf. Mayser, 69), more, greater;
__1. as adj.: Jo 15:2, At 18:2o, Hb 3:3; before παρά, Hb 11:4 (cf. Westc, in l. Was ΠΛΙΟΝΑ here a primitive error for ΗΔΙΟΝΑ ?); pi., At 13:31, al.; with genitive compar., Mt 21:36; with num. (ἤ of comp. omitted), At 4:22 24:11, al.
__2. As subst., οἱ π., the greater number: At 10:32 27:12, 1Co 10:5 15:6; also (Bl., §44, 3) others, more, the more: 2Co 2:6 4:15, Fp 1:14; πλείονα, Lc 11:53; πλειον, πλέον, Mt 20:10, 2Tm 3:9; with genitive comp., Mk 12:43, Lc 21:3; π. Ἰωνᾶ ὧδε, Mt 12:41; adverbially, At 4:17 20:9 24:4.
__3. As adv., πλεῖον: before ἤ, Lc 9:13; with genitive comp., Mt 5:20; πλείω: with num., Mt 26:53.
Superl., πλεῖστος, -η, -ον
, __(a) prop., most: Mt 11:20 21:8; adverbially, τὸ π., 1Co 14:27;
__(b) elative (M, Pr., 79), very great: ὄχλος π., Mc 4:1.
(AS)

G4185.def:
πολυτελής, -ές
(πολύς, τέλος) [in LXX for יָקָר, etc. ;]
very costly, very precious, of great value: Mc 14:3, 1Tm 2:9; metaphorically, 1Pe 3:4.†
(AS)

G4186.def:
πολύτιμος, -ον
(πολύς, τιμή)
__1. much revered (Menand.).
__2. very costly, very precious: Mt 13:46 26:7 (βαρύτιμος, WH), Jo 12:3; comparat., 1Pe 1:7.†
(AS)

G4187.def:
πολυτρόπως
adv. (πολύτροπος, 1. much turning. 2. manifold ), [in LXX: 4Ma.3:21 A * ;]
in many ways or manners: Hb 1:1 (Philo).†
(AS)

G4188.def:
πόμα, -τος, τό
(πίνω),
late form of Att.. πῶμα,
[in LXX.: Sl 102:9 (שִׁקּוּי), al. 4 * ;]
drink: 1Co 10:4, Hb 9:10.†
(AS)

G4189.def:
πονηρία, -ας, ἡ
(πονηρός), [in LXX chiefly for רַע ;]
iniquity, wickedness: Mt 22:18, Lc 11:39, Rm 1:29, Ef 6:12; pl. (see Bl., § 32, 6; WM, 220; Swete, Mk., 153), Mc 7:22, At 3:26; κακία καὶ π., 1Co 5:8.†
SYN.: see: κακία. (AS)

G4190.def:
πονηρός, -ά, -όν
(πονέω, to toil), [in LXX chiefly for רַע ;]
__1.
__(a) of persons, oppressed by toils (Hes.);
__(b) of things, toilsome, painful (καιρός, Sir.51:12): Ef 5:16 6:13 Ap 16:2.
__2. bad, worthless;
__(a) in physical sense: καρπός, Mt 7:17-18;
__(b) in ethical sense, bad, evil, wicked;
__(α) of persons: Mt 7:11 12:34-35 18:32 25:26, Lc 6:45 11:13 19:22, At 17:5, 2Ts 3:2, 2Tm 3:13; γενεά, Mt 12:39, 45 16:4, Lc 11:29; πνεῦμια, Mt 12:45, Lc 7:21 8:2 11:26, At 19:12-13, 15-16; as subst., οἱ π., opposite to δίκαιοι, Mt 13:49; to ἀγαθοί, Mt 5:45 22:10; οἱ ἀχάριστοι καὶ π., Lc 6:35; sing., ὁ π., Mt 5:39, 1Co 5:13; id. esp. of Satan, the evil one, Mt 5:37 6:13 (see Lft., Notes, 125 ff.; but cf. McN, in l) Mt 13:19, 38, Lc 11:4 (WH, R, om.), Jo 17:15, Ef 6:16, 2Ts 3:3 (Lft., Notes, l.with), 1Jo 2:13-14 Jn 3:12 Jn 5:18-19;
__(β) of things: Mt 5:11 12:35 15:19, Lc 6:22, 45, Jo 3:19 7:7, At 18:14 25:18, Gl 1:4, Cl 1:21, 1Tm 6:4, 2Tm 4:18, Hb 3:12 10:22, Tg 2:4 4:16, 1Jo 3:12, II Jn 11, 3Jn.10; ὀφθαλμός (which see), Mt 6:23 20:15, Mc 7:22, Lc 11:34; as subst., neut., τὸ π., At 28:21, 1Ts 5:22; opposite to ἀγαθόν, Lc 6:45, Rm 12:9; pl., Mt 9:4, Mc 7:23, Lc 3:19.
† SYN.: see: ἄθεσμος (AS)

G4192.def:
πόνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for עָמָל, etc. ;]
__1. labour, toil: Cl 4:13
__2. The consequence of toil, distress, suffering, pain (Xen., al., LXX): Ap 16:10-11 21:4.†
SYN.: see: κόπος (AS)

G4194.def:
Πόντιος, -ου, ὁ
Pontius, the prænomen of Pilate (see: Πειλᾶτος), Mt 27:2 (Rec., WH, mg.), Lc 3:1, At 4:27, 1Tm 6:13.†
(AS)

G4195.def:
Πόντος, -ου, ὁ
Pontus, a region of Asia Minor, bordering on the πόντος Εὔξεινος: At 2:9, 1Pe 1:1.†
(AS)

G4197.def:
πορεία, -ας, ἡ
(πορεύω), [in LXX chiefly for הֲלִיכָה and cogn. forms ;]
__1. a journey: Lc 13:22.
__2. a going: metaphorically ("the rich man perishes while he is still on the move," Hort., in l), Tg 1:11.†
(AS)

G4198.def:
πορεύω,
(πόρος, a ford, a passage), [in LXX chiefly for הלךְ ;]
in cl. (the act. becomes obsolete in late Gk.; see M, Pr., 162), to cause to go over, carry, convey. Mid. (always in LXX and NT), ־ομαι, to go, proceed, go on one's way: with accusative, ὁδόν, At 8:39; before ἐκεῖθεν, Mt 19:15; ἐντεῦθεν, Lc 13:31; ἀπό, Mt 25:41, Lc 4:42; εἰς, Mt 2:20, Mc 16:12, Lc 1:39, Jo 7:35, al; εἰς εἰρήνην (cf. 1Rs 1:17). Lc 7:50; ἐν εἰρήνῃ, At 16:36; ἐπί, with accusative, Mt 22:9, At 25:12, al; ἕως, At 23:23; οὗ, Lc 24:28, 1Co 16:6; πρός, with accusative of person(s), Mt 25:9, Lc 11:5, al.; κατὰ τ. ὁδόν, At 8:36; διά, with genitive, Mt 12:1, Mc 9:30; with inf., Lc 2:3, Jo 14:2; σύν, Lc 7:6, al.; ἵνα, Jo 11:11; absol., Mt 2:9, Lc 7:8, Jo 4:50, At 5:20, al.; ptcp., πορευθείς (on the pass. form of the aor., see M, Pr., 161f.), redundant (as in Heb. and Aram.; V. M, Pr., 231; Dalman, Words, 21), Mt 2:8, Lc 7:22, al. Metaphorical (cf. Soph., O.T., 884; Xen., Cyr., 2, 2, 24, al),
__(a) like οἴχομαι in cl., as euphemism for θνήσκω (so הלךְ in Gn 15:2); Lc 22:22 and perh. also 13:33 (see Field, Notes, 66);
__(b) in ethical sense (Dt 19:9, Sl 14:2, al; cf. M, Pr., 11.2; Kennedy, Sources, 107): before ἐν, Lc 1:6, 1Pe 4:3, 2Pe 2:19; κατά, with accusative, 2Pe 3:3, Ju 16, 18; with dative (Bl, §38, 3), At 9:31 14:16, Ju 11;
__(with) of disciples or partisans ( Jz 2:12, 3Ki.11:10, Sir.46:10): before ὀπίσω, with genitive of person(s), Lc 21:8 (cf. δια-, εἰς-, (-μαι), ἐκ- (-μαι), ἐν- (-μαι), ἐπι- (-μαι), παρα- (-μαι), προ-, προσ- (-μαι), συν- (-μαι)).
(AS)

G4199.def:
πορθέω collat. form (in cl. chiefly poët.) of πέρθω,
[in LXX: 4Ma.4:23 4Mac 11:4 * ;]
to destroy, ravage: At 9:21, Gl 1:13, 23.†
(AS)
